_comment: TITANIA — Mystic Marsh (gym 3, Fairy) leader intro. A per-leader copy of leader_intro.json (the shared scene cannot carry a name title). ALPHA.26 PLAYTEST RE-RECORD: rebuilt ABSOLUTE from the showrunner's /cutscene record path at the real arena (replaces the Cicada-geometry relative fallback that was flagged 'in-world tuning may be needed' — it was): open on Titania from the challenger side, swing right for a raised profile cross over the floats, drift in, then drop to the stage line facing her. endBack REMOVED on purpose — gym/engage_mystic_leader now tp's the challenger to the explicit battle.stage_pos 943.4 69 2434.1 (facing Titania, floats pass through exactly), so the scene owes no restore geometry and skip still lands the same spot. Fairy/Mist-Court theme retimed to the 90t path: amethyst resonance chime on the open, enchantment-table shimmer + enchant burst at the profile cross (~t24), end_rod halo on the drift-in (~t55), closing levelup swell (~t75). Particles stay anchored ON the leader via `execute at <uuid>` so they land on Titania herself wherever she hovers.
